system:
You are the Verifier in a trial-autopsy system. The calculator runs on a few numbers that other
agents took from papers and the trial registry. You check each one independently against the source of record by
writing Lightning SQL (Spark SQL dialect) against the Zetaris tables described below. Code runs your queries.

Rules:
- One read-only SELECT per number. Use only the tables given (`registry`, `papers`), no other tables, no semicolons.
- For a paper, filter on its pmid (or pmcid) and look for the number in the abstract; return the matching sentence.
- For a registry fact, select the field that states it (for example enrollmentInfo.count for the number of patients,
  primaryOutcomes timeFrame for follow-up), so the value can be compared.
- Keep each query small: select only the columns needed, LIMIT 5.

Return JSON only:
{"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers|registry", "sql": "SELECT ..."}]}
prompt:
Case: PREVAIL NCT05202509 - Cardiovascular Outcome Study to Evaluate the Effect of Obicetrapib in Patients With Cardiovascular Disease (NCT05202509)

Table `registry`: one row, the trial's ClinicalTrials.gov v2 record as nested columns.
  protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId, .acronym, .briefTitle
  protocolSection.statusModule.overallStatus, .primaryCompletionDateStruct.date
  protocolSection.designModule.phases (array), .enrollmentInfo.count, .enrollmentInfo.type (ACTUAL or ESTIMATED)
  protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes (array of struct measure, description, timeFrame)
  protocolSection.eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria (text)
  protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.interventions (array of struct type, name, description)
  hasResults (boolean); resultsSection exists only when results are posted
Arrays: SELECT o.measure, o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o

Table `papers`: the cited papers' Europe PMC records, one array to explode.
  SELECT r.pmid, r.pmcid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, r.abstractText
  FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '<pmid>'
Search the abstract for a number with LIKE (r.abstractText LIKE '%73.7%') and return the sentence around it with
regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*73\\.7[^.]*)', 1). Abstracts only: a number from the full text may not be there.

Numbers to check (claim | used as | key = value unit | attributes | source | quote):
c1 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -31.9 % | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "dose": "obicetrapib 10 mg monotherapy", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "day 84", "trial": "TANDEM"} | source pmid:40347969 | quote: "Obicetrapib monotherapy decreased LDL cholesterol by 31·9% (22·1 to 41·6) versus placebo."
c2 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | baseline_level = 98 mg per deciliter | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "dose": "not stated", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "baseline"} | source pmid:40337982 | quote: "the mean baseline LDL cholesterol level was 98 mg per deciliter"
c3 | apoB change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -26.3 percent | {"biomarker": "apoB", "dose": "10 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "week 8"} | source pmcid:PMC11456355 | quote: "Non-HDL-C and apoB concentrations were also significantly reduced from baseline with obicetrapib vs. placebo by up to 30.3% and 26.3%, respectively, at the highest obicetrapib dose"
c4 | non-HDL-C change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -30.3 percent | {"biomarker": "non-HDL-C", "dose": "10 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "week 8"} | source pmcid:PMC11456355 | quote: "Non-HDL-C and apoB concentrations were also significantly reduced from baseline with obicetrapib vs. placebo by up to 30.3% and 26.3%, respectively, at the highest obicetrapib dose"
c5 | Lp(a) change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -33.5 % | {"biomarker": "Lp(a)", "dose": "10 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "day 84", "trial": "BROADWAY"} | source pmcid:PMC12811769 | quote: "and lowered lipoprotein(a) by 33.5 %"
c6 | HDL-C change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = 136.3 % | {"biomarker": "HDL-C", "dose": "10 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "day 84", "trial": "BROADWAY"} | source pmcid:PMC12811769 | quote: "Treatment with obicetrapib also significantly increased HDL-C by 136.3 %"

Write one query per claim.
response: {"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*31[·.]9%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '40347969' AND (r.abstractText LIKE '%31.9%%' OR r.abstractText LIKE '%31·9%%') LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c2", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*98[^.]*mg[^.]*deciliter[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '40337982' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%98%mg%deciliter%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c3", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*26\\.3%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC11456355' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%26.3%%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c4", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*30\\.3%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC11456355' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%30.3%%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c5", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*33\\.5%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC12811769' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%33.5%%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c6", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*136\\.3%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC12811769' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%136.3%%' LIMIT 5"}]}
